flavor: A thick inflexible vine which grows cracked grey bark as hard as stone
ingredients: Rock Bark — Increase Defense by 2 · Rock Cambium — Restores Durability by 10
name: Rock Vine
stage1:
Creature: target gains +1 Defense. (Act.) Target Speed −3.
Ground: vines act as half cover for 2, up to 2m apart. (Act.) Thorns deal 2d4+Intellect to adjacent creatures every turn.
Activation cannot be undone.
stage2:
Creature: +3 Defense. (Act.) Speed −6.
Ground: full cover for 3, up to 2m apart. (Act.) Thorns 2d6+Intellect per turn.
stage3:
Creature: +5 Defense. (Act.) Speed −9.
Ground: full cover for 4, up to 2m apart. (Act.) Thorns 2d8+Intellect per turn.

flavor: A spiky tree with explosive fragmentation nuts
ingredients: Sandbox Nut — +3 Speed · Sandbox Sap — −3 Speed
name: Sandbox Tree
stage1:
Roots & grows: half cover; mountable for 3m of height.
(Act.) The tree FALLS in a chosen direction — half cover for 3 in a line, growth halts; crossing the cover deals 2d4+Intellect Stabbing. Once activated the tree dies.
stage2:
6m high; thorns are climbing footholds; full cover for 1.
(Act.) Falls — half cover for 6 in a line; targets hit take 2d8+Intellect Stabbing; crossing deals 2d6+Intellect.
stage3:
9m high; climbing thorns; full cover for 2. 2d4 Sandbox Nuts grow at the top — throwable 5m+Might for 2d6+Intellect Stabbing; nuts expire at the next Pulse.
(Act.) Falls — half cover for 9 in a line; landing on a target deals 2d8+Intellect Piercing + a 2m-radius explosion at 9m from the trunk dealing 2d6+Intellect Stabbing.

flavor: A short bush growing prismatic sparkling red berries
ingredients: Sparkle Berry — Restore 2d4 Endurance · Sparkle Berry Seed — negate the effect of 1 non-lethal wound
name: Sparkle Berry Bush
stage1:
Grows 1d4 Sparkle Berries — consume for 1 AP or 1 Reaction to heal 2d4 Endurance. Berries rot in 5 minutes.
(Act.) Berries turn red→green: deal 7 Poison damage, applicable to weapons/ammo with 1 AP, lasting 2 turns. Cannot be deactivated.
stage2:
+2d4 more berries (rot in 5 minutes).
(Act.) Green berries deal 2d4 Poison; apply to weapons/ammo 1 AP, 2 turns.
stage3:
+2d4 more berries — these heal 3d4 Endurance AND negate 1 non-lethal wound; rot in 5 minutes.
(Act.) Green berries 3d4 Poison; apply 1 AP, 2 turns.

flavor: A plushy dark green moss as soft as a pillow
ingredients: (Card prints Sparkle Berry's ingredients — copy-paste defect; Reece authors its own.)
name: Pillow Moss
stage1:
Ground: 2m-radius plush patch — sleeping on it recovers +5 Endurance from rest; fall damage halved when landing on it.
Creature: pillowy armor — resistance to stun damage, Speed −1.
Single-stage: no Rooting/Blooming, no activation.

flavor: A hanging verdant vine looking oddly like the hair of a scholar you know
ingredients: (Card prints Sparkle Berry's ingredients — copy-paste defect; Reece authors its own.)
name: Leanda's Hair
stage1:
Surface: clings hard and grows DOWNWARD — climbable up/down; can be cut & harvested into one 50m rope.
Ground: clings to its sprout surface and grows toward the Cultivator to 50m; harvestable into one 50m rope.
Single-stage. (Card cost conflict: header 2 AP vs body 1 AP — using 2.)

flavor: A small purple fungus with glowing pods releasing blue light
ingredients: Glow Paste — target releases light · Flash Flesh — resistance to flash-based blinding
name: Flash Fungus
stage1:
1d4 Flash Fungi grow. Each: smear on a surface/armament = 3m-radius light for 1 Pulse, OR throw = bright flash blinding targets in a 3m radius (Fortitude Save = Caster Intellect).
(Act.) All at once: smeared light glows twice as bright for 5 minutes then burns out; unthrown fungi also deal 2d4+Intellect Sonic when thrown. Destroys the plant.
stage2:
2d4 fungi; brighter; flash radius 5m.
(Act.) As Sprouting.
stage3:
3d4 fungi; flash radius 7m; thrown fungi Blind & Deafen.
(Act.) As Sprouting.

flavor: A white sticky lichen with long dread-like strands
ingredients: Web Dreads — makes 10m rope with 1 hour · Web Mucus — Climbing Speed = half normal
name: Cave Webs
stage1:
Grows a 2m-wide, 6m line in a chosen direction — can turn, climb walls, cross ceilings; climbable; creatures in it gain +5 effective Stealth.
FLAMMABLE: 2d4+caster Intellect Fire for 2 turns to creatures in its area if ignited.
(Act.) The surface turns sticky — grapples any creature passing through.
stage2:
+6m of growth; the caster can contract the lichen between two points — bridge/strand/wall within range.
(Act.) Sticky grapple.

flavor: A giant deep blue-red fungus with a swiss-cheese fruiting body
ingredients: Filter Flesh — Poison Resistance · Filter Blood — 5 Poison Damage
name: Filter Fungus
stage1:
Scrubs the air — replaces non-breathable gasses/dusts with breathable air in a 3m radius. Blue ichor applied to weapons changes their damage type to Poison.
(Act., usable TWICE) Launches poison gas in a 3m cone — 1d4+caster Intellect Poison — and redirects any absorbed effects into the cone.
stage2:
Radius 5m; coated armaments gain +1d4 Poison.
(Act.) 5m cone, 2d4+Intellect Poison + absorbed effects.
stage3:
Radius 7m; coatings +2d4 Poison.
(Act.) 7m cone, 3d4+Intellect Poison + absorbed effects.

flavor: A rapidly growing orange vine which releases a sweet-smelling resin
ingredients: Ember Resin — 5 Fire Damage · Orange Vine — Restore & +5 max Endurance
name: Ember Vine
stage1:
Equipment (1 AP to sprout there): strikes with the armament change damage type to Fire. (Act.) +2d4 Fire for 1 turn.
Ground (2 AP): vines spread 2m radius; fire attacks DETONATE them — 2d4+Intellect Fire in 2m. (Act.) Same explosion on demand.
Activation costs 10 Reagents and KILLS the plant.
stage2:
Equipment: +1d4 Fire on strikes. (Act.) +3d4 Fire for 1 turn.
Ground: 3m radius; explosion 3d4+Intellect in 3m.
stage3:
Equipment: +2d4 Fire on strikes. (Act.) +4d4 Fire for 1 turn.
Ground: 4m radius; explosion 4d4+Intellect in 4m.

flavor: An orange pitcher plant containing green sticky caustic liquid
ingredients: Pot Snot — 5 Acid Damage · Pot Flesh — Acid Resistance
name: Snot Pots
stage1:
1d4 Snot Pots grow — grab & throw within 5m+Might: 1m-radius 2d4+Intellect Acid explosion; or apply to an armament (1 AP): damage type becomes Acid.
(Act.) ALL pots explode (2d4+Intellect Acid, 1m each); acid-applied armaments deal +1d4 Acid for 1 turn; growth stops. 10 Reagents, kills the plant.
stage2:
2d4 pots; thrown same; armament application also +1d4 to strikes.
(Act.) As Sprouting.
stage3: (Card defect: LVL 3 text repeats LVL 2 verbatim — Reece to author the real Blooming.) 2d4 more pots; same numbers as Rooting.

flavor: A snot-colored vine which grows rapidly towards metallic objects
ingredients: Finger Bark — +4 against being Disarmed · Finger Cambium — +2 Might
name: Goblin Fingers
stage1:
Ground: burrows, 2m radius — creatures walking over it are DISARMED of metal armaments or GRAPPLED if wearing metal armor (Attribute Save = Caster Intelligence). (Act.) Vines harden: save DC +1.
Armor: wraps the wearer's armor — catches arrows/bolts/slow metal missiles, half cover even while flanked; Speed −1. (Act.) Hardens: +1 Defense, Speed −1.
(Card prints NO activation cost — using 5 Reagents until Reece prices it.)
stage2:
Ground: 3m radius; targets save each metre travelled. (Act.) Save DC +2.
Armor: full cover even while flanked, Speed −2. (Act.) +2 Defense, Speed −2.
stage3:
Ground: 4m radius. (Act.) Save DC +3.
Armor: works against fast projectiles like bullets, Speed −3. (Act.) +4 Defense, Speed −3.
